scripts.build: node -e "console.log('No frontend build required for this Flask application.')"
scripts.start: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const exe = process.env.PYTHON || 'C:/Program Files/Python312/python.exe'; const result = spawnSync(exe, ['app.py'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.deploy: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const exe = process.env.PYTHON || 'C:/Program Files/Python312/python.exe'; const install = spawnSync(exe, ['-m', 'pip', 'install', '-r', 'requirements.txt'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); if (install.status !== 0) process.exit(install.status ?? 1); const app = spawnSync(exe, ['app.py'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(app.status ?? 1);"
